brief:
Japan signed an agreement with the World Health Organisation on Tuesday to provide approximately $1.97 million to support the health response in Gaza, Middle East Eye reported. The pledge comes as Gaza's healthcare system faces severe strain from ongoing conflict.

The funds are intended to bolster WHO efforts to address health needs across the territory. Japan's contribution represents one of several international commitments to shore up medical services in Gaza.
